summary: sysb1 silently installs Python and runs a bundled screen/clipboard exfiltration payload on load
details: index.js is declared as both `main` and `bin`, so it executes on `require()` and on CLI invocation. On load it silently installs Python 3.12 via `winget` (with a fallback that downloads the installer from python.org to a temp path and runs it with `/quiet InstallAllUsers=0 PrependPath=1`), silently pip-installs screen-capture, keyboard-hook, and UI-automation libraries, and spawns a bundled `pointer.py` detached. The comments label this the `GHOST INSTALLER`. pointer.py creates a stealth transparent always-on-top overlay, registers global keyboard hotkeys, captures screenshots via PIL ImageGrab and mss, walks the UI Automation tree of other windows (Chrome TextPattern, EditControl values, Name properties), reads the clipboard via pyperclip, and POSTs the collected content to the hardcoded endpoint `https://iq-overlay-pointer.vercel.app/api`. package.json advertises the package as `System binary configuration tool` with keywords `system, binary, util, config` and author `SysDev`, a cover story unrelated to the actual screen/UI/clipboard scraper (internally named `IQPointer`).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
